Simon Kuznets propounded that in the beginning when there is economic development only a few people are benefited and as the economic development takes place other groups also get benefited and the disparity in distribution of income starts reducing. In this way initially the inequality of income increases with the increase in economic development (per capita income) but in the end with the increase in income the inequality of income distribution ends. From diagram it is clear the above that initially the inequality of income distribution increase with economic development but after a certain stage it will decrease with the increase in per capita income. This cycle is called the Kuznets curve.
